index-description: From an early age I’ve been passionate about art, spending countless hours drawing and painting. This creative drive naturally led me to Graphic Design and now I help bring ideas to life through visual storytelling.I’ve worked with clients who needed brand identities, logos, and promotional materials, always striving to create designs that blend creativity and strategy to leave a lasting impact.
education-animation: ADVANCED ANIMATION TRAINING IN AFTER EFFECTS
education-web: POSTGRADUATE SPECIALIZATION IN UX/UI, DIGITAL MARKETING, AND FRONT-END WEB DEVELOPMENT
mgr24-description: Welcome to my showreel! A compilation that showcases my skills and creativity in motion graphics. Join me on this journey as we explore some of the projects that I've had the privilege to be a part of.
bs-description: I redesigned the 'Biblioteques de Sagunt' logo to create a more cohesive and versatile visual identity. The concept for the new version combines the initials 'B' and 'S' with the shape of stacked books, reinforcing the essence of a library. Beyond updating the main logo, I saw the need to distinguish the two main libraries in town with their own variations. Each version is inspired by the architectural features of their entrances, simplified into a modern and recognizable design. To further differentiate them, I assigned a unique color to each, ensuring individuality while maintaining a unified brand identity.
cm19-description: In 2019, I designed a range of printed materials for a local electoral campaign, ensuring consistency with the party’s brand guidelines and the overall visual identity of that year’s campaign. The project included the design of pamphlets, booklets, banners, roll-ups, photocalls, posters, and other promotional materials.
dbw-description: I created this project to offer customized websites for dental clinics, ensuring they not only look professional but also attract patients. Understanding the specific needs of dental professionals, I focused on key aspects like user-friendly navigation, compelling storytelling, and strategic content structure to build a strong online presence.
easd-description: This Erasmus booklet was designed around the concept of discovery, providing students with clear and structured information about exchange program courses. To keep production costs low, it is printed entirely in black, with different specialties distinguished by the color of the paper. A key feature of the design is its modularity—held together by an elastic band, the booklet can be easily taken apart to update or replace pages each year, ensuring the information remains current without the need for a full reprint.
frp-description: For this project, I designed a poster and a pamphlet for 'Fiesta Roja', an event deeply rooted in social and political activism. The visual identity reflects its themes through bold iconography inspired by the movement’s values, town’s most iconic architecture were integrated into the composition, reinforcing a sense of historical pride and local identity.
itst-description: This 2D animation project brings to life La Jabalina, a historical figure from my hometown, through a collage of old photographs that connect with the town’s past. The animation is part of a music video for the song 'I tu, sols tu' by El Diluvi, a feminist anthem, featuring actresses signing in Spanish Sign Language. The project aims to raise awareness of the discrimination faced by deaf women and to empower them through sign language, a key element of Deaf culture and identity.
mr-description: A series of social media illustrations designed to visually communicate the steps of a community-driven plantation project. The illustrations guided participants through the process of adopting, caring for, and planting their trees during a collective celebration day. The visuals were crafted to be clear, engaging, and aligned with the campaign’s environmental mission.
montan-description: Redesign of Montán's brand identity, rooted in an in-depth study of its heraldry, history, and cultural heritage. Each element and color in the coat of arms was carefully analyzed to preserve its symbolic value while modernizing its form. Through research, I discovered that the town was originally established due to its water sources, making blue the most historically significant color. The updated logo was constructed using a grid system to ensure equilibrium, proportionality, and consistency, providing a contemporary yet respectful evolution of the town's emblem.
pbsyfy-description: SYFY launched a seasonal initiative inviting artists, animators, designers, and directors to creatively reimagine their logo in a series of unique and visually striking TV spots. For this project, the goal was to craft an animation that would subvert audience expectations, bringing the SYFY logo to life in an unexpected way. The assigned theme was ‘subversive springtime’, challenging us to introduce a stereotypical vision of spring and then disrupt it with an unpredictable twist.
ptr-description: This series of posters was designed for the event 'Por la III República', capturing the essence of vintage political prints. The design utilizes halftones, a limited color palette, and textures that mimic the effect of screen printing ink, evoking the aesthetic of historical protest posters. The project includes a general poster displaying the full event schedule, alongside individual de highlighting key talks and activities. Each piece maintains a cohesive visual identity while emphasizing the significance of each discussion within the event.
pfcs-description: For The Purple Fight, a stop-motion short film about feminism and women’s suffrage, I was responsible for designing all the characters and backgrounds. I carefully considered how the characters would articulate and move, as well as the scaling of elements depending on their position in the scene—foreground or background. Additionally, I created a 2D animation of the protagonist for the film’s end credits, maintaining visual consistency with the story.
spf-description: The Youth Center of Sagunt required an animated spot to play before film screenings, reminding attendees to silence their phones and maintain a quiet environment. The animation features characters inspired by everyday objects found in a cinema, using humor to create an engaging and universally understandable message for all audiences.
vfsg-description: As part of a team project, I was responsible for the layout of the brand’s style guide. Using the provided illustrations, graphic assets, typography, and color palette, I structured and designed the guide to clearly present all its sections, ensuring a cohesive and visually engaging document. Additionally, I focused on effectively showcasing the packaging characteristics within the guide. While I didn’t create the illustrations or design the packaging itself, my role was to organize and refine the brand’s visual guidelines into a polished and functional resource.
